intro1: I’m a creative director based in Mumbai. I began as a music journalist at Rock Street Journal, became a copywriter at Webchutney and Wunderman, and went on to lead creative at JWT and McCann for brands like Ford, Google and IKEA. In 2023 I co-founded Neon Owl Studios, where we make films and build brands.
intro2: These days I’m moving towards marketing and strategy roles. Most recently I built the website and devised the marketing and advertising strategy for satyaspeaks.co. I’m also the founder-editor of The Moto Globe, I build small software tools, and with my trusty Fujifilm, I enjoy street photography.

projects.title: Satya Speaks
projects.short: A new home for Satya Speaks: talks, courses, writings and a members’ community in one place. I built the site and planned how it reaches people.

story.t: Satya Speaks had outgrown its earlier website. It needed one place for talks, courses, writings and a members’ community, and a plan for bringing people to it.
I built the new website and devised the marketing and advertising strategy for its launch, across the newsletter, YouTube, Substack and Spotify.
Launched in November 2026. A launch promo film is in production.

projects.title: Gatefold
projects.short: A pitch and funding tool for creative professionals. One shareable link holds the whole project, with version history and funding built in.

story.t: Creative work is still pitched with tools built for corporate decks. A filmmaker builds slides, emails them around, and collects feedback through scattered texts and voice notes. There is no single source of truth, no version history, and no way to raise money without leaving the platform.

Every project gets one link. It holds eight required fields, from logline to budget range, up to eighteen optional sections, a horizontal “Flow” of images, video and sound that lets someone feel the project’s arc, every past version, and an optional funding section with direct payments.
Not a deck generator, a marketplace or a social feed. AI helps only when asked and never overwrites what a creator wrote.
A near-black canvas, two functional colours and three typefaces, built on Dieter Rams’ idea that nothing should be on it that isn’t doing a job.
In active development. Next.js, Supabase, Stripe and Razorpay, on Vercel.

projects.title: pwd start
projects.short: Free, hands-on lessons that teach how AI, software, hardware, the internet and security work, for people starting from zero.

story.t: Most technical courses assume you already speak the language. pwd start is for people with no technical background who want to understand the tools they now use every day.

Short lessons across five paths: Orientation, Security, Software, Hardware and AI. No videos, no memorising. You poke at small simulations, answer a few quick questions, and finish each stage by making something real. XP and levels keep score.
My own learning journal. Each path follows what I have worked through myself.
Free. No account, nothing to install, and progress stays on your device.

projects.title: Lulu-fm
projects.short: A music discovery platform built from my own library: about 67,000 songs from my YouTube Music and Spotify likes and followed artists, in one player.

story.t: Years of listening, spread across two services. Lulu-fm brings it into one real library: every song I have liked and every artist I follow on YouTube Music and Spotify, about 67,000 tracks.
Illustrated scenes of Lulu, our cat, fill the screen while one small player at the bottom plays from both services.
Live, and shared on Instagram and X.

projects.title: Royal Enfield
projects.short: Five training films for Royal Enfield’s showroom sales and customer teams, told as scenes from the showroom floor.

story.t: A series for Royal Enfield’s sales and customer relations teams. Each film takes one part of the sale: the test ride, decision-making and pricing, upselling and cross-selling, customer relations, and a summary.
I directed the series, staging each lesson as a scene between customers and staff on the showroom floor.
The decision-making and pricing film is on Vimeo, and all five are on my YouTube channel.

projects.title: Rebel Foods
projects.short: A rap film for FAASOS’ #HungerSaver initiative, featuring Kaam Bhaari. Over a million views.

story.t: #HungerSaver is FAASOS’ initiative to give back to the thousands of underprivileged children in the city’s gullies who struggle to get a good meal.
The #HungerSaver (w)Rap, featuring Kaam Bhaari, shot on location in Juhu, Mumbai.
Over a million views and 21,000 likes on YouTube.
